tours.title: Sun World Ba Na Hills Ticket - Da Nang
tours.description: Experience the world-record cable car, stroll across the legendary Golden Bridge, explore the romantic French Village, and enjoy endless fun at Fantasy Park.

itinerary.activity: Morning: Take cable car to the top, visit Golden Bridge, Debay Wine Cellar. Noon: Buffet lunch. Afternoon: Enjoy Fantasy Park.

tours.title: Ha Long Heritage 5-Star Cruise
tours.description: Enjoy a luxurious vacation on Ha Long Bay - a World Natural Heritage Site. Experience kayaking, swimming, sunbathing, and sunset party on the Sundeck.

itinerary.activity: 12:00 Board the ship, buffet lunch. Afternoon: Visit Sung Sot Cave, kayak at Luon Cave. Evening: Set menu dinner, live music.
Morning: Tai Chi on deck, visit Titop Island. Enjoy bay views, light lunch and return to port at 11:00.

tours.title: Mount Fuji & Oshino Hakkai Village Day Tour
tours.description: Behold the majestic Mount Fuji from the famous 5th Station, enjoy the scenic Kawaguchi Lake and stroll through the peaceful Oshino Hakkai village with its pristine ponds.

itinerary.activity: 08:00 Depart from Shinjuku. 10:00 Arrive at Mt. Fuji 5th Station. 13:00 Visit Ninja Oshino Hakkai Village. 16:00 Check-in at Kawaguchi Lake.

tours.title: Discover Paris: Eiffel Tower & Seine River Cruise
tours.description: Experience the romantic City of Light. Ascend the Eiffel Tower for panoramic views of Paris and cruise along the scenic Seine River.

itinerary.activity: Morning: Visit Eiffel Tower 2nd floor. Afternoon: Board Bateaux Parisiens for a sunset cruise along the Seine River

tours.title: Colosseum & Roman Forum Special
tours.description: Travel back in time to the golden age of the Roman Empire. Explore the mysteries of the Colosseum and the ancient Roman Forum.

itinerary.activity: Skip-the-line entrance to Colosseum. Visit underground ruins and stroll through Roman Forum.

tours.title: Manhattan Helicopter Tour
tours.description: Behold the beautiful New York City from above, admire the Statue of Liberty, Empire State Building, and Central Park.

itinerary.activity: 15-minute safe helicopter flight with 180-degree views. Enjoy champagne after the flight.

tours.title: Bali Jungle Swing & Tegallalang Rice Terraces
tours.description: Experience the ultimate photo opportunity at the famous Jungle Swing, visit the lush green Tegallalang rice terraces and the mysterious Sacred Monkey Forest.

itinerary.activity: Explore Ubud Monkey Forest. Enjoy Bali Swing. Visit Tegallalang Rice Terraces.

tours.title: Nami Island & Petite France Village
tours.description: Stroll along the famous metasequoia tree-lined paths from Winter Sonata. Visit the colorful romantic French village.

itinerary.activity: Depart from Myeongdong. Ferry to Nami Island. Lunch: Chicken stir-fry with cabbage. Afternoon: Visit Petite France Village.

tours.title: Sydney Opera House & Harbour Cruise
tours.description: Witness the magnificent architecture of the Opera House floating on the water and enjoy a coffee while viewing the Sydney Harbour Bridge.

itinerary.activity: Inside tour of Opera House. Afternoon: Sunset cruise around Sydney Harbour.

tours.title: London Eye & The London Dungeon
tours.description: Take in all of beautiful London from 135m above on the giant ferris wheel then experience the chilling underground thrills.

itinerary.activity: 30-minute London Eye ride. Continue to The London Dungeon to explore its dark history.

tours.title: Gardens by the Bay & Supertree Observatory
tours.description: A futuristic world with massive indoor conservatories Cloud Forest and beautiful Flower Dome. Walk the OCBC Skyway for stunning views.

itinerary.activity: Visit 2 ecological domes and walk OCBC Skyway. Enjoy the evening light show at 19:45.

tours.title: Dubai Desert Safari & BBQ Dinner
tours.description: Challenge your speed with dune bashing, ride camels at sunset and enjoy traditional belly dance performance.

itinerary.activity: 14:00 Hotel pickup in 4x4 Land Cruiser. Dune Bashing. BBQ dinner buffet at desert camp.

tours.title: Wat Phra Kaew & Asiatique Night Market
tours.description: Marvel at the majestic grandeur of the Grand Palace and enjoy shopping and street food at the beautiful riverside night market.

itinerary.activity: Morning: Visit Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew. Late afternoon: Free time to take boat to Asiatique.

tours.title: Venice Grand Canal Gondola Ride
tours.description: Glide through the charming canals of Venice, passing through quiet streets of Europe to the melodious singing of the gondolier.

itinerary.activity: 30-40 minute romantic sightseeing cruise around major canals and Grand Canal.

tours.title: Acropolis & Acropolis Museum Tour
tours.description: Climb the mythological Acropolis hill to see the majestic Parthenon temple, guardian of Greek civilization and democracy.

itinerary.activity: Tour the Acropolis complex for 2 hours. Noon: Free Gyros with traditional sauce.

tours.title: Giza Pyramids & Camel Riding Experience
tours.description: Conquer the only remaining Wonder of the Ancient World in one golden afternoon.

itinerary.activity: Visit 3 major pyramids and Sphinx. 1-hour camel riding experience in the desert.

excluded: Ticket to enter inside the pyramids

tours.title: Machu Picchu Heritage Day Trip
tours.description: Take the train through the sacred valley to reach the Lost City of the Inca - a masterpiece nestled in the Peruvian jungle.

itinerary.activity: Inca Rail train from Cusco. Bus to the mountain and full 3-hour tour of the ruins.

tours.title: Cappadocia Hot Air Balloon Tour
tours.description: Wake up early to watch thousands of giant hot air balloons rise over the fairy chimneys rock formations.

itinerary.activity: 04:30 Hotel pickup. 1-hour sunrise flight. Certificate and champagne celebration.

excluded: Transportation from other countries to Turkey

tours.title: Maldives: Submarine Tour & Stingray Snorkeling
tours.description: Explore the pristine coral reefs of the Indian Ocean in the unique Whale Submarine.

itinerary.activity: Submarine dive to 40m depth to view pristine coral reefs. Then relax on canoe at water surface.

tours.title: Cape Peninsula & Boulders Penguin Colony
tours.description: Breathtaking views at the edge of the world where two oceans meet, and play with thousands of tiny African penguins.

itinerary.activity: Drive via the world-famous Chapman Peak Road. Visit Cape of Good Hope and walk at Boulders Beach.
